source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 22 May 1958, p. 5 ("The Belfast results"); Irish News, 22 May 1958, p. 1
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: figures from the News-Letter's ward-by-ward results (OCR checked against the Irish News list of the same day); printed majorities recomputed; unopposed aldermen as the News-Letter's results list marks them ('ret. unopposed')

note: Triennial election of Belfast Corporation, polled Wednesday 21 May 1958: 90 candidates for 53 seats (45 councillors and the aldermen of eight wards); contests in 13 of the 15 wards (Belfast News-Letter, 8 and 9 May 1958). Aldermanic seats were filled in eight wards. The ward's printed poll of 3,447 (with 213 spoiled) is the councillors' poll: the aldermanic votes and 174 spoiled papers come to 3,431, so it is not used as this poll's total. Northern Ireland Labour gain from the Unionists: Harcourt, a former Lord Mayor and a member since 1927, lost his seat.
